title: Cujo
author: Stephen King
summary: In a small Maine town, a friendly St. Bernard is bitten by a bat and becomes dangerous. A mother and her young son end up trapped in a broken-down car on a hot summer day while their marriage is also under strain.
readIf: you want a stripped-down, edge-of-the-seat survival thriller with a very ordinary threat.
skipIf: you do not want to read about a dog's suffering or a child in danger.

pairings.reason: Another story where an animal terrorises a small community, with a similar mix of family drama and danger.
A survival story of a different kind, hopeful where this one is bleak.
A different threat but the same close, claustrophobic focus on a mother protecting children.
